rules.title: Privileged account without MFA registration
rules.action: Confirm the role assignment is still needed, then require MFA registration before privileged use.

rules.title: Privileged account password older than threshold
rules.action: Review the account lifecycle and rotate or move the account to a stronger privileged-access process.

rules.title: Enabled account with stale interactive sign-in
rules.action: Confirm owner and business need before disabling, archiving, or excluding from access.

rules.title: Directory sync error older than threshold
rules.action: Resolve the source attribute conflict and confirm the object returns to a clean sync state.
